english.title: Cause the use of a coach / bus / goods vehicle without a speed limiter plate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CON AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) a

(A)_[coach,]_
(B)_[bus,]_
(C)_[goods vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) and which was fitted with a speed limiter without being equipped in a conspicuous position in the driving compartment with a plate which was clearly and indelibly marked with the speed at which the speed limiter had been set
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 70A(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was fitted with a speed limiter. The driving compartment was not equipped with a plate in a conspicuous position and showing the speed at which the speed limiter had been set.
